issue.title: Repair bob-cli agents sidecar digest drift and clear its publication outbox residue
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-fa.4 (epic sase-fa) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; re-verified by the sase-fa land agent. NOT caused by sase-fa: per scope decision 4 of plans:202608/revert_async_sidecar_publication.md the epic deliberately left bob-cli untouched.

Current state, re-verified today with 'sase doctor --json':

- state.agent_publication_digest WARN: 2 drifted hood-snapshot files, all in gh_bobs-org__bob-cli - 'qa: agents/bbugyi200.athena.qa--plan/prompt.md' and 'sj: agents/bbugyi200.athena.sj--plan/prompt.md'. The sase project itself is clean (sase-fa.4 repaired its 73 drifted files).
- state.agent_publication_outbox WARN: 11 requests, all in gh_bobs-org__bob-cli - 9 quarantined, 2 retired. Failure modes are mixed: 4 'file digest mismatch' (the drift above blocks them, since load_validated_publication verifies every signed reference before publishing anything), 3 'hood sase-ez has no publishable runs', and 1 'published agent page for bbugyi200.athena.sase-ez.4 did not materialize during full sync' (that last one is the family/container page-path defect tracked separately as sase-fh).

The tool for the drift half now exists: 'sase agent sync --repair-digests -p bob-cli' (added by sase-fa.4), which re-derives each locally owned hood snapshot from on-disk payload, re-signs the owner manifest, and is a no-op when digests already match.

Scope and sequencing caveat: repairing digests is targeted and safe, but clearing the quarantined/retired requests runs a full sync of bob-cli, which is exactly the operation canceled task sase-f6 documents as re-synthesizing retired identities from immutable SASE_AGENT commit footers (sase-f6 was closed 'canceled' in the 2026-08-05 backlog triage, with an explicit invitation to +1 it with fresh evidence). So: run --repair-digests first and confirm state.agent_publication_digest goes clean; then decide whether to clear the outbox residue, and if a full sync does resurrect retired bob-cli identities, capture that as fresh evidence on sase-f6 rather than papering over it.

payload.entry: Verified via 'sase doctor --json'. (1) Ran 'sase agent sync --repair-digests -p bob-cli': re-signed the 2 drifted hood snapshots (qa, sj); state.agent_publication_digest is now OK with zero drift. (2) Ran 'sase agent sync --drop-retired --retry-quarantined -p bob-cli' (a full sync) to clear the outbox residue: outbox went from 11 issues (9 quarantined, 2 retired) down to 2 stalled requests, both bbugyi200.athena.sase-ez.4 'did not materialize during full sync' failures already tracked separately as sase-fh (left untouched, out of scope here). (3) The full sync did resurrect previously-retired identities gh_bobs-org__bob-cli-2 (+family .1-.4, .land) and gh_bobs-org__bob-cli-5 (+.5.5) from immutable commit footers, reproducing the bug sase-f6 documents; per this bead's own instructions I did not paper over it by re-retiring them, and instead filed a +1 with commit-hash evidence on sase-f6, which is now reopened (status=ready).
